# World catalog

*Generated by `scripts/gen_data.py` — edit `blender/world_data.py`, not this file.*

**19 spaces · 218 discoverable objects · 1179 blockout structures**

Every object below is a real entry in the data: it has a position, a prompt, a behaviour, and where it earns one, a secret and a reason to come back. Grey-box it with the Blender builder, walk it, then art it.

| Wardrobe | Customize | Character creator access without re-entering the Machine. |  |

| Object | Prompt | What it does | Rewards a second look |

| The Bust | Hold cup under chin | A marble bust pours coffee. Nobody in the city finds this remarkable. +Stamina. | Every twentieth cup is not coffee. |
| The Complaining Door | Try handle | Locked, and it explains at length exactly why, and whose fault it is. | Tell it you agree and it unlocks. |
| Staircase to Nowhere | Climb | Ends in open air two storeys up. | Keep walking upward anyway and the next step appears. |
| The Payphone | Answer | Rings whenever a player walks past. Someone is on the line and knows your name. |  |
| The Puddle | Look in | Reflects a version of this street that is on fire. Yours is not. |  |
| The Chair That Waits | Sit | Moves a little closer whenever no player is looking at it. |  |
| The Mailbox **(2P)** | Open | Holds a note another player left in this reality. |  |
| The Loud Painting | Approach | Plays music, audible only within two metres of it. |  |
| The Chandelier | Watch | Swings to point at the nearest player. | After dark it points at something else entirely. |
| The Bureaucrat's Desk **(2P)** | Stamp form | Stamping the form moves a wall somewhere else in the district. |  |
| The Elevator | Ride | Six buttons. Four go to floors. | The fifth goes to a floor that is not in this building. |
| The Telescope | Look through | Shows other realities. | Once in a while it shows this street, from behind you. |
| Building That Breathes | Touch | The facade expands and contracts. Warm to the touch. |  |
| The Suggestion Box **(2P)** | Write | Whatever you write shows up somewhere in the city later. |  |
| Traffic Light Choir | Listen | Three lights, singing in harmony. They change key when a car passes. |  |
| The Fountain | Drop item in | Give it an item, get a different one back. Rarity is roughly preserved. |  |
| Reality Weapon Cache **(2P)** | Open | Contains the Gravity Gun (Reality class) behind a two-player lock. |  |
| The Eye of Reality | Take | Legendary artifact. Origin: Reality 07. Status: unknown. | Only appears once the city has rearranged itself three times. |

|---|---|---|---|
| The Trade Ring **(2P)** | Trade | The bartering floor. Two-sided offers, both confirm (Part II 39). |  |
| Appraiser's Stall | Appraise | Tells you what an artifact is actually worth. Charges for the opinion. |  |
| The Fence | Sell | Buys anything, asks nothing, pays badly. |  |
| Currency Exchange | Exchange | Credits, Shards and Tokens (Part II 38). Rates move with player activity. |  |
| Furniture Row | Browse | Trailer decor. The healthiest thing in the shop. |  |
| The Auction Board **(2P)** | Bid | Player-listed rare items on a timer. |  |
| Weapon Tinker | Upgrade | Applies upgrade paths to weapons you already own (Part II 37). |  |
| Potion Row | Buy | All five potions, marked up. Cheaper to brew them yourself. |  |
| The Empty Stall **(2P)** | Claim | Any player can claim it for an hour and sell their own finds from it. |  |
| Rumour Table **(2P)** | Listen | NPCs repeat things players have actually done in other realities. |  |
| The Locked Case | Examine | Contains something nobody in the market will name. | Opens to whoever brings the Eye of Reality here. Do not sell it. |
| Lantern Line | Light | Lighting the whole street opens the night market. |  |
